hooks.command: git fetch -q origin main && { [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" != true ] || git switch -q main; } && { [ "$(git branch --show-current)" != main ] || git merge --ff-only -q origin/main; } || echo "main not switched to or origin/main not merged, fix it per git.md"; if [ -d node_modules ]; then CHECK_LOCK_WAIT_MS=0 bun run --silent check-lock bun install --frozen-lockfile; else bun install --frozen-lockfile; fi || echo "bun install --frozen-lockfile failed or a running gate holds the lock: run it before your gate"
